name: Strategy001 EMA20/50 cross with Heikin-Ashi confirm
author: Gerald Lonlas (freqtrade-strategies)
entry_long: EMA20 crosses above EMA50 AND HA_close > EMA20 AND HA_open < HA_close (green HA bar)
exit: EMA50 crosses above EMA100 AND HA_close < EMA20 AND HA_open > HA_close (red HA bar) [exit signal; exit_profit_only=True so only exits in profit]
stop_loss: fixed -10%; trailing_stop False (trailing params defined but disabled)
implementation_notes: Odd exit: uses EMA50>EMA100 cross. Heikin-Ashi values must be computed without lookahead. Long-only. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
